domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with regrouping and simplification

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into a subtraction-ready form, such as adding a zero fractional part, converting an improper fractional part to a standard mixed number, or separating whole and fractional parts before subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator to align with a mixed number or fraction.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is converted to an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when a quantity is explicitly decomposed into whole and fractional parts to set up subtraction, before any borrowing occurs.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the step's main purpose is to find a common denominator or create equivalent fractions.
Do not tag direct subtraction of already compatible whole and fractional parts.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping during subtraction after a negative fractional difference has appeared.
Do not tag final simplification or combining of the result.

skills.name: Match denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite one or both fractional parts as equivalent fractions so they can be subtracted.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions with the same denominator.
Tag for mixed-number problems when only the fractional parts are rewritten to a common denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no equivalent-fraction conversion is performed.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as n + 0/d unless the step also performs common-denominator conversion.
Do not tag borrowing steps that add d/d to a fraction after taking 1 from the whole part.
Do not tag subtraction or simplification steps.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with like denominators and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts of mixed numbers once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag when whole and fractional parts are subtracted directly after normalization or denominator matching, provided no borrowing is performed in that step.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps that create common denominators or equivalent fractions.
Do not tag preprocessing rewrites of operands into standard form.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps used because the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.
Do not tag simplification-only or final-expression-only steps.

skills.name: Regroup or simplify
skills.definition: Borrow one whole when needed to continue subtraction, and/or reduce and express the result in lowest terms or standard final form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when 1 whole is borrowed from the whole part and converted into denominator-over-denominator for the fractional subtraction.
Tag when a negative fractional difference triggers regrouping from the whole part.
Tag when a fraction is reduced to lowest terms, a zero fraction is simplified to 0, or whole and fractional parts are combined into a final mixed number or integer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag straightforward subtraction steps that require no borrowing and no simplification/final expression.
Do not tag initial operand normalization before subtraction begins.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion before subtraction.
